source: CalPERS Private Equity Program Fund Performance Review
selection_method: CalPERS holdings in named technology-focused manager families with an initial investment in 2012 or later; excludes secondary and co-investment positions. Fund-level returns are not attributable solely to AI.
important_limitations: Quarterly private-fund disclosures are published with a reporting lag.
Investment year reflects the reporting LP's first investment, and may differ from fund vintage.
Each LP's cash flows describe its own holdings. The displayed cohort uses one source and observation date.
CalPERS discloses active partnerships; exited partnerships are excluded.
